title: SRS→KST Bridge

A_correctness_purity.notes: No I/O, no Date.now(), no Convex or app imports. Pure/deterministic. stabilityToRetention used correctly. Card-based retention takes priority over proficiency retentionStrength.

B_security.notes: No prototype pollution, no eval, no Function(). Safe optional-chaining reads. Evidence objects constructed from scratch.

C_api_coherence.notes: DefaultSrsToKstBridge, buildKstState, ConvertArgs exported from index.ts. Interface SrsToKstBridge preserved. No Convex/app types leak to callers. SrsCardState extended with optional lastReviewedAt (backward-compatible).

implementation_summary: Implemented DefaultSrsToKstBridge class (implements SrsToKstBridge) with convert() method producing Map<NodeId, KnowledgeStateEntry> via getKnowledgeState. Evidence-building logic: per-objective card (most recent by lastReviewedAt, then stability) + per-objective proficiency (positional last-wins). Card stability takes priority for retention computation; proficiency provides isProficient and fallback retention. Added buildKstState convenience function: bridge → getKnowledgeState → getOuterFringe. Re-exported stabilityToRetention from srs-bridge module for consumer reuse.
